name: ol-copc
description: Cloud Optimized Point Clouds (COPC) for OpenLayers, top-down or in a tilted view

scripts.lint: eslint tasks test src/ol-copc examples config
scripts.fix: eslint tasks test src/ol-copc examples config --fix
scripts.pretest: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.build-examples: shx rm -rf build/examples && vite build --config examples/vite.config.mjs
scripts.build-package: npm run generate-types && node tasks/serialize-workers.js && node tasks/prepare-package.js
scripts.apidoc-debug: shx rm -rf build/apidoc && node --inspect-brk=9229 ./node_modules/jsdoc/jsdoc.js --readme config/jsdoc/api/index.md --configure config/jsdoc/api/conf.json --package package.json --destination build/apidoc
scripts.apidoc: shx rm -rf build/apidoc && jsdoc --readme config/jsdoc/api/index.md --configure config/jsdoc/api/conf.json --package package.json --destination build/apidoc
